title: Starbloom Isles
tagline: Hop, stomp, and bloom: light the beacon across the floating sky.
pitch: Starbloom Isles: a bright, juicy toon 3D platformer. A little fox hops across floating sky islands, rope bridges and moving platforms collecting glowing star blooms, stomping grumpy slimes, and reaching the beacon portal on the last island. Cheerful, saturated, sunny.
controls: Space: jump (tap again mid-air to double-jump)

plan.title: Starbloom Isles
plan.tagline: Hop, stomp, and bloom: light the beacon across the floating sky.
plan.core_loop: Hop and double-jump across floating sky islands, rope bridges and bobbing platforms, grabbing star blooms and stomping slimes until 20 blooms light the beacon portal on the last island.
controls: Space: jump (tap again mid-air to double-jump)
plan.win_condition: Collect 20 Star Blooms and step into the beacon portal on the final island.
plan.lose_condition: Fall off the islands into the void and lose all 3 lives.
plan.art_direction: Saturated candy-toon palette: tangerine fox with cream chest, mint-green island grass, butter-yellow-to-sky-blue gradient sky with big cotton clouds, coral and lavender accents. Chunky rounded geometry with soft ink outlines, glowing star blooms with bloom halos, sunny rim light and warm shadows. Bouncy, cheerful, everything reads at a glance.
concept_shots: The fox lands on a floating grass island with squash-and-stretch, a dust puff and a sparkle ring; a row of glowing star blooms spins above the path and a rope bridge sways toward the next island behind.
Mid-air: the fox double-jumps over a grumpy wide-eyed slime patrolling a plank, a star-burst pops on the stomp, and a bobbing platform floats below the wide gap.
The final island: the tall beacon portal ignites in rings of light as the fox sprints in, confetti bursts, and the whole archipelago glows against the sunny sky.

features: Bobbing mover platforms over the wide gaps between islands (level movers + Physics.addKinematic)
Rope-bridge plank paths between key islands (World.prop 'bridge' + colliders)
Spring pads that launch the fox up to higher islands (World.prop 'spring_pad')
Stompable patrol slimes: hit flash, squash and a star-burst on stomp (Gameplay.spawnEnemy 'patrol' + FX.hitFlash + FX.starBurst)
Void falls: poof + screen shake, respawn at the last checkpoint island (HAZARDS 'void' + FX.poof + FX.shake)
Beacon portal juice: pulsing light rings as blooms are collected, full ring + confetti + banner when the target is hit (FX.ring + FX.confetti + UI.banner)
plan.mapping_notes: The fox maps directly to Player species 'fox' with a scarf. 'Star blooms' use the kit's 'star' collectible tag, labelled Star Blooms, with a custom glowing star-flower HUD icon and starbloom props to sell the theme. The beacon portal is the goal portal in collect mode - it opens once 20 of 30 blooms are banked. Grumpy slimes are 'patrol' enemies, stompable. Rope bridges and moving platforms come from the sky_islands level dressing plus 'bridge' props and kinematic movers. No timer keeps the mood cheerful; 3 lives cover void falls. toon_bright look + follow camera match the pitch exactly.

result.summary:
Starbloom Isles: a bright candy-toon 3D platformer built on the scaffold. A tangerine fox with a scarf hops and double-jumps across floating sky islands, rope bridges and the level's own bobbing/stepping platforms, collecting glowing Star Blooms and stomping grumpy slimes until 20 of 30 blooms light the beacon portal on the final island. 3 lives cover void falls; no timer keeps the mood cheerful.

Kept everything the pipeline scaffolded (generated sky panorama, starbloom/sky-lantern props + splat landmarks, arcade HUD with the custom star-bloom counter, title screen, collect rules, FX.auto, Audio.auto, Debug.install) and layered the plan's features on top with kit calls only.

Verified with play_game: zero console errors every run, no deaths, autopilot follows the route, collects 27-29/20 blooms, the beacon opens (goalOpen true, "Light the beacon!" objective + banner) and the fox reaches the goal island.
changes: Re-tagged the level's coin placements to 'star' (Star Blooms) and set the collect rule to target 20 of 30 with the 'Star Blooms' label
Added a live objective callback: 'Collect N more Star Blooms' -> 'Light the beacon!' once the portal opens
Beacon portal juice: idle gold/cyan sparkle glow on the portal, a light ring every 5 blooms banked, and on goalOpen a cyan ring + star burst + 'The beacon is lit!' stage-clear banner
Stomp juice: star burst + 'STOMP!' floating text when the fox stomps a slime
Void-fall juice: cream poof + screen shake on player death
Win juice: full-screen confetti in the palette colours + a big star burst at the beacon

Tried spring pads and a custom kinematic bobbing platform, then removed them because they disrupted the autopilot route (the level already ships its own movers, rope bridges and stepping platforms that handle every gap)
known_issues: The autopilot reliably collects 20+ blooms and reaches the goal island, but in a 25s test window it sometimes stops just short of stepping into the portal, so 'won' is not always observed in a single run — a human player (or a few more seconds) completes the win; the win path and all win FX are wired and fire correctly
One slime/turret on a mid-route island can cost the fox a hit (hp drops to 1-2), which is intended enemy pressure, not a bug
